diagnosis: The Hocuspocus CRDT collaboration server validates user tokens during onAuthenticate but omits object-level authorization in onLoadDocument. Because data.documentName is accepted without cross-referencing data.context.user against the document's authorized user list or organization, any authenticated user can join, inspect, and mutate arbitrary private documents.
